bbb.script17.cod.0000071b: You told me to change... I gave myself a cyber makeover...
bbb.script17.cod.0000073f: Hmm... no worse than the white beard...
bbb.script17.cod.0000075b: Don't get me started! All that hair made eating soup impossible!...
bbb.script17.cod.0000077d: Well... do you still want to play with us?...
bbb.script17.cod.000007a5: But hang on... what proves you're really Santa Claus?...
bbb.script17.cod.000007cd: You're getting on my nerves... You want proof?...
bbb.script17.cod.000007eb: Well, here!... Here are some presents!...
bbb.script17.cod.0000081a: All right, all right! I'm used to it...
bbb.script17.cod.0000084a: Well, children? Back to see Santa Claus?...
bbb.script17.cod.0000087c: I know, I know, but I'm not used to it...
bbb.script17.cod.00000898: Doesn't it feel strange being just a mouth and two eyes?...
bbb.script17.cod.000008be: Oh dear! You have no idea! And look at this mouth! I look like Mrs. Claus!...
bbb.script17.cod.000008f0: Your voice is very sensual too...
bbb.script17.cod.00000908: Don't remind me! Even my reindeer make fun of me!...
bbb.script17.cod.00000928: They're not the only ones! ARF ARF ARF!...
bbb.script17.cod.0000095f: Thank you for sticking up for me...
bbb.script17.cod.0000098c: Oh, thank you, Santa Berquizz! Too kind...
bbb.script17.cod.000009a6: True, too kind, but I have to. It's my job...
bbb.script17.cod.00000a68: Say... have you noticed how often you get a choice?...
bbb.script17.cod.00000aac: It's nice having a choice, isn't it?...
bbb.script17.cod.00000b1c: Don't you want to blow everything up in this crazy universe?...
bbb.script17.cod.00000bb2: So? Strike trouble?... That won't help you finish the mission!...
bbb.script17.cod.00000bdc: For sure... we're messing up the plot...
bbb.script17.cod.00000bfc: But luckily... you believe in Santa Claus...
bbb.script17.cod.00000c44: What? Aren't my presents good enough???
bbb.script17.cod.00000c74: Good... that's better... Because I'm about to give you a real gift from heaven...
bbb.script17.cod.00000ca4: You're going to end the strikes?...
bbb.script17.cod.00000cb8: Better than that, better than that!...
bbb.script17.cod.00000d11: The one to shut your mouth! Ha ha ha!...
bbb.script17.cod.00000d2b: Ha ha! Very clever! You certainly don't give me any presents!...
bbb.script17.cod.00000d8e: It's Christmas after all! So I'm giving you another chance!...
bbb.script17.cod.00000db0: A new race with amazing powers... they'll help you...
bbb.script17.cod.00000e79: Oh! Atomic weapons... interesting... Thank you, Commander...
bbb.script17.cod.00000fd7: That should calm him down... Commander...
